info.name: Bird GBFS Feed Discovery Vehicles API

items.docs: Returns every vehicle type operating in this Bird city. Typical responses include an `electric` scooter (form_factor=scooter) and an `electric_assist` bicycle (form_factor=bicycle), each with a max_range_meters value.

Returns the real-time list of available free-floating Bird vehicles in this city. Each entry includes bike_id, lat, lon, is_reserved, is_disabled, vehicle_type_id, and current_range_meters / battery information. Updated every 60 seconds.
